newsitem.title: UK: MSAS expands network into Latin America.
newsitem.headline: MSAS expands network into Latin America.

text.p: MSAS Cargo International said in a statement it is expanding its network into Latin America.
MSAS Cargo International de Mexico, SA de C.V. is starting the network expansion in Mexico via a majority-owned joint venture with Central de Aduanas de Mexico.

Operations will begin on January 1, 1997 from a headquarters located in Mexico City with branch offices in Monterry, Guadalajara, Acapulo, Nuevo Laredo, Veracruz, Toluca, and Laredo, Texas and offer a wide range of logistics solutions, including air and sea import and export operations, customs brokerage, warehousing, distribution and logistics consulting services.

Roger Haeussler, MSAS vice president for Latin America, will oversee MSAS de Mexico's growth and performance, while the company's day-to-day operations will be supervised by Luis Torres, MSAS' country manager.

MSAS Americas chief executive, Mick Fountain said "This is our first move in line with our strategic initiative to be a leading player in the Latin American market. In the coming 18 months, we will continue this development by joint venture or acquisition." - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
